review_state: corrected assembly source and aligned owner candidate pair; rail identities unproved
observation: The correct .009 source view is the upper-left placement photograph 114553710, not the previously cited centre-right view 114611058. Its C90 vertical outline sits just outside the upper portion of D15's left socket edge. In owner component photograph PXL_20260710_200354648.jpg, two filled annuli near (370,1465) and (365,1680) are vertically aligned about 215 px apart in the matching upper-left strip. At original resolution, neither visibly joins the adjacent bundle of long front-copper traces; this improves their geometric candidacy. Other open annuli beside the socket lie on a different inner path. No capacitor body is fitted, and neither candidate annulus has been proved to join its expected supply rail.
native_candidate_identity_check: Crop (100,1250)-(600,1800) of 200354648 shows both proposed C90 marks as separate drilled annuli west of the blue D15 socket, not socket contacts. The upper around (370,1465) is just left of the socket's upper corner; the lower around (365,1680) is left of a lower socket contact. Their front face shows no bridge between them. This validates the two distinct physical search features but does not assign either one to C90 or a rail.
solder_side_limit: The solder photograph 200514102 covers the reflected D15 region. The D15 A2/A1 record gives component-side hole centres near (429,1927)/(431,1972), but its solder-side coordinates (2965,2085)/(2962,2129) lie on horizontal trace segments in the original-resolution image, not at clearly visible matching drill centres. Those pairs cannot be used as point correspondences for a two-face transform. The proper outboard solder strip is to the right of the reflected D15 contact row near image x=3210, before the board-edge rail near x=3430. It contains an open annulus near (3280,1643) and another near (3285,1943), plus a filled joint near (3310,1790). Their y spacing and copper routes do not by themselves establish which, if any, correspond to the component-side C90 candidates. No +5/GND assignment is justified.
pin_pitch_cross_check: The visible D15 component-side socket contacts near x=455 are spaced about 55 px vertically; the reflected solder contact row near x=3210 has roughly 50 px pitch. The component-side C90 candidates are about 215 px apart, so a same-view solder pair should be separated on the order of 195 px after a local D15 pin fit. The two obvious outboard open solder annuli at y=1643 and y=1943 are 300 px apart and should not be adopted together as the C90 pair merely because their x coordinates align. The filled joint near y=1790 is a separate candidate feature, but the pin-index match and rail continuity are still missing.
outboard_strip_native_reread: A native-resolution crop of solder photo 200514102 at (3110,1510)-(3430,2160) shows the joint near (3310,1790) entering a broad vertical copper strip that continues downward beyond the crop. The open annulus near (3280,1643) is on a separate thin horizontal trace above it; the open annulus near (3285,1943) is visibly separate from the broad strip. This distinguishes three candidate conductors in the C90 search area. The subsequent D15 row alignment below narrows the candidate solder features; it does not establish same-hole identity or the broad strip's supply rail.
d15_row_alignment_reread: Native front crop (390,1430)-(530,2330) of 200354648 shows 14 D15 left-row socket contacts with first/last centers near y1554/2273. Native solder crop (3120,1600)-(3290,2450) of 200514102 shows the corresponding outboard D15 joint row with first/last centers near y1683/2349. A two-endpoint linear y fit gives solder y≈0.926*front y+244, placing front C90 candidate centers y1465/1672 near solder y1601/1792. This is a search-grade row fit, not a validated two-face hole transform. At those y values, the bright soldered part of the upper broad horizontal strip near (3310,1580) and the joint beginning the broad vertical strip near (3310,1790) have a compatible roughly 210 px vertical spacing, but the two-row x fit below rejects them as confident same-hole counterparts. The two open outboard annuli at y1643/1943 are 300 px apart and cannot both be the projected pair under this fit. The subsequent D15.26 and D25.10/.9 traces identify the vertical and horizontal strips as +5 V and ground conductors, respectively; those rail identities do not identify the front C90 holes.
d15_two_row_x_recheck: Front photo 200354648 shows D15 socket-row x centers near 430 (outboard) and 735 (inboard); solder photo 200514102 shows the corresponding mirrored rows near x3210 and x2910. The 305 px front and 300 px solder spacings give a local reflection x_solder≈3633−0.984*x_front. Front C90 annuli near x370/365 therefore project near solder x3269/3274. The proposed broad-strip solder joints are near x3310, a 36–41 px mismatch (roughly 1.8–2.1 mm at D15's observed pin pitch). This x check supersedes the earlier vertical-spacing-only pair hypothesis: the two rail-identified strips are useful nearby anchors but are not a reliable physical C90 pad assignment. Perspective and joint-center uncertainty prevent proving isolation, but the pair must be independently same-hole registered before any footprint placement.
projected_window_native_check: Native crop (3170,1530)-(3390,1860) of solder photo 200514102 enlarged threefold shows the projected upper position near (3270,1601) on the broad horizontal strip but without a distinguishable separate joint center; the projected lower position near (3274,1792) falls in bare substrate between the D15 contact row and the vertical strip joint at x≈3310. No drilled or soldered feature is resolved at that lower projected point. This weakens the two front annuli as a photo-registered C90 pair under the present local transform; it does not prove they are blind features or absent holes, because an independent same-hole fiducial and perspective correction are still lacking.
vertical_strip_d15_power_join: In native solder crop (2950,1550)-(3400,2750) of 200514102, the broad vertical strip from the candidate joint near (3310,1790) descends and turns left into the D15 outboard solder-row joint near (3210,2247), with visible continuous copper. The 14-contact row runs top to bottom from D15 pin15 at y≈1683 to pin28 at y≈2349 because the front package notch faces down; joint 12 at y≈2247 is D15 pin26. Exact .009 sheet-1 power table assigns D15.26 to +5 V. Thus the vertical strip has a photo-visible route to a source-assigned +5 V pad, though owner electrical continuity and the C90 front-to-back same-hole match remain unmeasured. The upper broad horizontal strip's rail is still unidentified.
upper_strip_ground_search: Native solder crop (2600,1450)-(3500,1900) shows the upper broad horizontal strip across the D15 region, with two local soldered spurs into joints on the separate row above and a bright splice near its right end. The D15 pin14 ground contact is in the opposite package row below this strip; no exposed local B.Cu branch directly joins that contact to the broad strip in this crop. D15 proximity alone does not identify the rail. The following D25 contact registration supplies the missing rail anchor.
upper_strip_d25_ground_join: The two soldered spurs on the upper broad strip near (2755,1545)/(2805,1545) meet the two rightmost lower-row contacts of the notch-left D25 20-pin package above D15. Front photo 200354648 shows that package and the right-end contact order; the source PCB's D25 footprint has pin10 at the rightmost lower position and pin9 immediately left, both named GND. The exact .009 sheet-1 power table independently gives D25.10 as ground. Mirroring the local contact order puts the rightmost front contact at the left spur on the solder face. Thus the upper broad strip has visible back-copper joins to the D25.10/.9 ground contacts. The front C90 upper annulus still lacks a validated same-hole match to this strip, and direct owner continuity remains unmeasured.
source_context: The .009 assembly places vertical C90 immediately left of D15. Sheet-1 draws C90 in the C82-C93 +5 V-to-ground bypass group.
decision: Keep C90 unplaced and do not treat any two nearby signal-route vias as a bypass pair without opposite-face or continuity evidence.
next_inspection: Search around the two-row projected positions near solder (3270,1601)/(3274,1792) for the actual counterparts of front annuli (370,1465)/(365,1672). The rail-identified strip joints at x≈3310 are roughly 40 px too far outboard under the local x fit; do not adopt them as C90 holes from vertical spacing alone. Distinguish the open holes at (3280,1643)/(3285,1943) separately, and meter only confirmed same-hole landings before assigning C90. The D15 auxiliary A2/A1 cut holes near component (429,1927) and (431,1972) are separate features.
